name: Dead Man’s Hands
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (the withered hand of a humanoid or monstrous humanoid corpse) Darken Forest

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You transform your hands into wicked, filthy, dirt-caked claws. You gain a single natural attack each round that deals 1d6 points of damage at your normal attack bonus. You can still deliver touch attack spells while your hands are transformed.
